title: The geometry of CP symmetry in Kaluza-Klein models
summary: We investigate the free, massless Dirac equation $Dψ= 0$ on a higher-dimensional manifold $M_4 \times K$ equipped with a submersion metric. These background metrics generalize the Kaluza ansatz. They encode 4D massive gauge fields and Higgs-like scalars, alongside the usual metric on $M_4$ and massless gauge fields. In this framework, the interactions of 4D gauge fields with spinors are determined by the Kosmann derivatives of the spinors' internal components.
